headline: US probes Megaspeed over Nvidia AI chip exports to China
summary: The US Justice and Commerce Departments confirmed a criminal investigation into Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company suspected of helping ship high-end Nvidia AI chips to China in violation of export rules. Megaspeed was previously run by the woman officials have accused of being a Chinese spy who had an affair with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

claims.statement: The Singapore-based company Megaspeed is suspected of helping ship high-end Nvidia AI chips to China, violating US export rules.
